يختطون (form VIII)
# يَخْتَطُونَ (yaḵtaṭūna) /jax.ta.tˤuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَطَى (iḵtaṭā)
# يُخْتَطَوْنَ (yuḵtaṭawna) /jux.ta.tˤaw.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَطَى (iḵtaṭā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
